handbookNote: North Dakota Real Estate Broker license exam. Part of the 2026-09-03 R26 population-tier broker buildout (population order: UT > NV > IA > AR > KS > MS > ID > NE > WV > HI > NH > MT > RI > DE > SD > ND > AK > VT > WY). Exam vendor: PSI Services LLC, under contract with the North Dakota Real Estate Commission (NDREC) (bulletin dated 10/1/2025). North Dakota recognizes a real THIRD license tier, 'Broker Associate' -- a licensee who holds a full broker-level license but works under another broker/firm rather than serving as that firm's designated (principal) broker, distinct from both Salesperson and designated Broker. National/general portion: 90 scored items (worth 100 points -- some broker items score up to 2 points each, the same PSI scoring quirk seen in HI/NH/other PSI states), 150 minutes. North Dakota State portion: 40 scored items, 90 minutes. Combined: 130 items, 240 minutes, flat $134 fee covering either or both portions. Passing score is a FLAT 75%, National and State scored/passed INDEPENDENTLY (retake only the failed portion). track_registry models this as exam_question_count=130, exam_duration_sec=14400, pass_percent=75, min_correct=98 (round(130*0.75)). NATIONAL PORTION (75 raw items reused, 11 sections) reuses the exact same real PSI national item bank as Iowa/Mississippi/Hawaii/New Hampshire -- confirmed structurally identical via the official PSI bulletin's content outline. NORTH DAKOTA STATE PORTION (40 items, 4 sections -- NOTE: PSI's own bulletin does NOT publish a per-section item-count breakdown for the State portion, a real disclosed gap in the source material itself, not a research shortfall; drafting was sized by real topical breadth per section instead of a numeric target): Duties and Powers of the Real Estate Commission (real NDCC 43-23 Commission composition/investigation/hearing/appeal process, incl. the real distinction that unlicensed practice is a Class B misdemeanor under NDCC 43-23-17 while a trust-account statute violation is only an infraction), Licensing Requirements (real Salesperson/Broker/Broker Associate distinctions under NDCC 43-23-05.1/43-23-06.1, 90-hour salesperson + 60 additional broker prelicensing hours, real reciprocity provisions under NDCC 43-23-10), Statutory Requirements Governing the Activities of Licensees (largest section, 12 real sub-areas incl. broker-only Branch Office/License Display, Trust Accounts, and Record Keeping -- real 24-hour trust-deposit rule and 6-year record retention under NDAC 70-02-01-15), and Additional Topics (North Dakota's real Subdivided Lands Disposition Act under NDCC Chapter 43-23.1 -- registration/disclosure requirements, a $25,000 indemnity bond floor, and a Class C felony penalty for violations -- plus broker-only closing-statement duties under NDCC 43-23-11.1(1)(o), and the Real Estate Education, Research, and Recovery Fund). Governing law: NDCC Chapter 43-23 (State Real Estate Commission) and Chapter 43-23.2 (Real Estate Education Fund), with disciplinary hearings/appeals procedure incorporating NDCC Chapter 28-32 (Administrative Agencies Practice Act). Real Estate Education, Research, and Recovery Fund CONFIRMED PRESENT under NDCC 43-23.2 -- $15,000 per-transaction cap (43-23.2-03) and separately $15,000 per-licensee cap (43-23.2-08), funded by a one-time $20 initial-licensure fee with a $60,000 fund-floor replenishment trigger, 4% annual interest on both claim-priority satisfaction and licensee repayment. This bank was drafted across 4 new state-topic drafting passes (the 11 national files were reused, not redrafted). Answers were deterministically rotated into final A/B/C/D position via scripts/tracks/rotate_broker_answers.js.
